auth.toSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in

errors.emailTaken: There is already an account with this email.

onboarding.title: Let's set Kenn up
onboarding.subtitle: Two minutes, and the checklist is dated from your own pregnancy.

genderForm.question: How should we address you?
genderForm.help: You can change this at any time in settings.

household.label: Household name
household.help: Just so you recognise it. You can change it later.

dating.question: How should we date the pregnancy?
dating.help: An ultrasound beats a remembered period, and an IVF transfer beats both.
dating.lmpDate: First day of the last period
dating.transferHelp: We assume a day-5 transfer. For a day-3 transfer the dates run two days early — check them against your clinic.

fetuses.question: How many babies?
fetuses.help: It changes some of the tests, and the birth grant.

profile.question: A few more things
profile.help: Each answer here hides or shows recommendations. All of them can be skipped.
profile.rhHelp: Decides whether the antibody screen and anti-D appear. If you do not know, leave it on “Not said”.

errors.invalid: Something in the form is not valid — check the date.

today.title: Today
today.gestationHelp: Counted from the dating you set.
today.nothingDue: Nothing due today. That is fine.
today.lateCount: {count, plural, one {one item is late} other {# items are late}}

tasks.saveFailed: That change was not saved. Try again.

invite.title: Invite the other parent
invite.help: The link is made here and can be sent in a message. It is valid for seven days.
invite.linkHelp: This link is shown once only — all we keep is a hash of it.
invite.invalidEmail: That email is not in a valid format.

join.title: An invitation to Kenn
join.body: This invitation joins you to one household with one checklist.
join.signInFirst: You need an account to join. We will come back here after you sign in.
join.invalid: This link is not valid — it may have expired, been revoked, or already been used.
join.taken: This account already belongs to a household. In this version you can be in one household only.

errors.notFoundBody: The link has probably changed or expired.

calendar.title: Add to your calendar
calendar.help: Every window appears in your calendar as an all-day event, with reminders the morning it opens and three days before it closes. Google Calendar shows the events without the reminders; Apple Calendar shows them too, unless they are removed when subscribing.
calendar.privacy: Test names will appear in your calendar, so your calendar provider sees them too. Anyone holding the link can read them — do not share it.
calendar.howTo: In Google Calendar: Other calendars → From URL. On iPhone: Settings → Calendar → Accounts → Add Subscribed Calendar. In Apple Calendar, untick “Remove alerts” when subscribing, or the reminders will not appear.
calendar.rotate: Create a new link — the current one stops working
calendar.linkHelp: This link is shown once only. Making a new one cancels the old one.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Kenn needs a connection to show your household. None of it is stored on this phone.
